f.applicability: Prescription drugs subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance (EPPV); replaces PFSB/SD Notification No. 0324001 (2006); English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails; the translation is not legally binding)

rows.quote:
The marketing authorization holder (hereinafter referred to as “MAH”) shall prepare an
    early post-marketing phase vigilance implementation plan in accordance with the
    provision of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Ministerial Ordinance on Good Vigilance
    Practice for Drugs, Quasi-drugs, Cosmetics, Medical Devices, and Regenerative
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory kept ('shall' with GVP Ordinance Art. 10(1) cited). f.title: Explain EPPV and request cooperation from medical institutions before delivery, face-to-face or online via MRs
f.statement: The MAH shall, in principle before delivery of the drug, provide medical institutions that use the drug with an explanation and request for cooperation through a face-to-face or online meeting by medical representatives, etc. The content is: the drug is subject to EPPV and the survey is ongoing; medical institutions should make an effort to use the drug properly; and if any serious adverse reaction or infection suspected to be related to the drug occurs, medical institutions should promptly report it to the MAH.
f.applicability: Prescription drugs subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance (EPPV); replaces PFSB/SD Notification No. 0324001 (2006); English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails; the translation is not legally binding)
f.exceptions: If the explanation and request for cooperation by medical representatives cannot be provided before delivery, the written-notice fallback in MHLW-EPPV-0531-1-2022-0004 applies.

rows.deadline: In principle before delivery of the drug
rows.quote:
The MAH shall provide the following explanation and request for cooperation to medical
  institutions which use a drug manufactured and marketed by the MAH, in principle,
  before delivery of the drug, through a face-to-face or online meeting by medical
  representatives, etc.
    If the explanation and request for cooperation by medical representatives, etc. cannot
  be provided before delivery, the contents of the explanation and request for cooperation
  shall be notified in writing before delivery, and the explanation and request for
  cooperation shall be provided by medical representatives, etc. within approximately 2
  weeks after the start of delivery.
   The drug is subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance and the survey is ongoing.
   Medical institutions should make an effort to use the drug properly. If any serious
     adverse reaction or infection suspected to be related to the drug occurs, medical
     institutions should promptly report it to the MAH
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory kept ('shall'). Quote also spans the fallback paragraph (needed to reach the explanation content that follows it); the fallback duty is stated only in -0004, so no duplication in the statement. Double-check: flag checked: 'shall' and actor are explicit, but the quote has to span the fallback paragraph to reach the explanation content, and the content bullets have no closing punctuation. Added a cross-reference to -0004 in exceptions. Below 90 for the quote structure.

f.title: Repeat requests for cooperation about every 2 weeks for 2 months after delivery start, then about monthly
f.statement: The MAH shall make requests for cooperation to medical institutions that use the drug, in principle approximately once within 2 weeks for the 2 months after the start of delivery, and at an appropriate frequency (approximately once within 1 month) thereafter.
f.applicability: Prescription drugs subject to early post-marketing phase vigilance (EPPV); replaces PFSB/SD Notification No. 0324001 (2006); English translation by PMDA provided for reference only (the Japanese original prevails; the translation is not legally binding)

rows.review_note: Review: no change ('shall'; 'in principle' kept). Double-check: verified: 'shall', MAH actor, frequencies and 'in principle' are all in the quote.

f.title: Submit the EPPV report with the implementation plan to PMDA within 2 months after the EPPV period ends
f.statement: The MAH shall submit the early post-marketing phase vigilance report, along with the early post-marketing phase vigilance implementation plan, within 2 months after the end of the early post-marketing phase vigilance period to the Office of Pharmacovigilance I or Office of Pharmacovigilance II of PMDA.
